meta.title: CK3 Mod Dev
meta.description: CK3 mod development agent preset (1.21.0.3 Florin) plus 8 ck3mod_* tools: validation, build, deploy, headless smoke test (suite global-variable attribution), log triage, vanilla lookup, workshop preflight (local copy / first upload / ugc / launcher rewrite) and status overview (upload IDs); ships 1.21 migration notes, a three-tier fact model backed by a generated CK3 Wiki atlas, dependency and shared-window discipline, in-game acceptance scene protection, and workshop release verification with optional scripted in-game clicking (mouse only).
